notes:
{交流|こうりゅう} has two distinct meanings: interpersonal/cultural exchange and alternating current (electricity). The interpersonal sense is far more common in everyday usage.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {交流|こうりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS (exchange):
- {交流|こうりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to interact, exchange
- {交流|こうりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧: to deepen exchange/interaction
- {交流|こうりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to promote exchange
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{交流|こうりゅう}: international exchange
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧{交流|こうりゅう}: cultural exchange
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{交流|こうりゅう}: student exchange

TECHNICAL USE (electricity):
- {交流|こうりゅう}⟦{電流|でんりゅう}→電流：21016_denryuu⟧: alternating current (AC)
- Opposite: ⟦{直流|ちょくりゅう}→直流：16656_chokuryuu⟧ (direct current, DC)

USAGE:
As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb, {交流|こうりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to interact or have exchange with others. Often used in institutional or organized contexts (exchange programs, cultural events).
